title: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round as it eyes global AI sensor market | TechCrunch
summary: Bharat Semi , an Indian semiconductor startup, has raised $24 million in seed funding to develop AI-enabled image sensors, as it seeks to win customers in the United States and elsewhere.
